stores_contact_email_check.name: stores_contact_email_check
stores_contact_email_check.value: "stores"."contact_email" is null or (char_length("stores"."contact_email") <= 254 and position('@' in "stores"."contact_email") > 1)

stores_contact_phone_check.name: stores_contact_phone_check
stores_contact_phone_check.value: "stores"."contact_phone" is null or char_length("stores"."contact_phone") between 4 and 32

generated.as: case when product_id is not null then 'product' else 'collection' end

template_assignments_kind_matches_resour.name: template_assignments_kind_matches_resource_check
template_assignments_kind_matches_resour.value: "template_assignments"."template_kind" = case when "template_assignments"."product_id" is not null then 'product' else 'collection' end

templates_draft_check.name: templates_draft_check
templates_draft_check.value:
jsonb_typeof("templates"."draft") = 'object'
      and coalesce(jsonb_typeof("templates"."draft" -> 'schemaVersion') = 'number' and ("templates"."draft" ->> 'schemaVersion') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$', false)
      and octet_length("templates"."draft"::text) <= 262144

tenants_contact_phone_check.name: tenants_contact_phone_check
tenants_contact_phone_check.value: "tenants"."contact_phone" is null or char_length("tenants"."contact_phone") between 4 and 32

product_variants_sku_check.name: product_variants_sku_check
product_variants_sku_check.value: "product_variants"."sku" is null or char_length("product_variants"."sku") between 1 and 64

products_sku_check.name: products_sku_check
products_sku_check.value: "products"."sku" is null or char_length("products"."sku") between 1 and 64

customers_email_check.name: customers_email_check
customers_email_check.value: char_length("customers"."email") between 3 and 254 and position('@' in "customers"."email") > 1

customers_phone_check.name: customers_phone_check
customers_phone_check.value: "customers"."phone" is null or char_length("customers"."phone") between 4 and 32
